title: Industrial Boom! China's Industrial Large Model Enterprises Exceed 62,000, with a Sharp Increase of 22,000 New Registrations This Year
excerpt: According to the latest data released by Tianyancha, the number of existing companies related to industrial large models in China has officially exceeded 62,000
content_html:
According to the latest data released by Tianyancha, the number of existing companies related to industrial large models in China has officially exceeded 62,000. Particularly noteworthy is that within a short period since 2026, approximately 22,300 related companies were newly registered nationwide, demonstrating an extremely strong development momentum and industrial vitality.

From a regional distribution perspective, the number of companies in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, and Beijing ranks among the highest in the country. The highly concentrated industrial performance in these regions is not accidental; it corresponds to the solid industrial foundations locally accumulated over the years, including electronics manufacturing, equipment manufacturing, software services, and artificial intelligence research and development, which jointly promote the deep integration of industrial large models with the real economy.
